description.narrative: Active engagement of CBOs/CSOs in policy implementation and development via established stakeholder platforms to adapt to climate change for the benefit of all people. Key activities: Output 1.1: - Conduct comprehensive organisational and thematic capacity assessments of CSOs/CBOs and implementing partners to inform tailored support plans. - Develop context‑adapted capacity‑building plans and training modules (PCM, climate change, DRR, organisational development, financial management etc). - Deliver modular trainings, coaching and mentoring, with partner‑specific action plans. - Facilitate multi‑stakeholder consultations for annual planning, especially with youth organisations and local authorities, to co‑create climate action strategies and support. Output 1.2: - Convene and document regular coordination meetings supporting aligned CSOs/CBOs action and learning. - Deliver trainings on context analysis, advocacy, and produce context maps with integrated mitigation measures. - Facilitate co‑creation and joint advocacy processes between youth CSOs/CBOs and local authorities, including development of climate‑related advocacy strategies and action plans. - CSOs/CBOs with practical advocacy skills, simulations, and coaching to produce knowledge products. Output 1.3: - Prepare, implement and monitor small grants. - Deliver core capacity‑building support, including PCM, grant management, governance, finance and HR related topics. - Facilitate organisational self‑assessments, preparation of Institutional development plans, and provide ongoing technical support and progress monitoring for CBOs/CSOs. Output 2.1 - Support CSOs/CBOs to conduct context analyses to inform targeted action plans and the design of community‑based DRR/CCA and environmental initiatives. - Organise planning workshops, alongside co‑development sessions with CSOs/CBOs, networks, youth groups and stakeholders to shape joint climate and disaster‑risk actions. - Support CSO/CBO‑led action research on priority issues and co‑design participatory outreach events with specific groups. - Deliver inclusive community events, analyse data, produce community‑level reports, and feed findings back to communities and authorities to inform follow‑up action. Output 2.2 - Strengthen collaboration of CSOs/CBOs by facilitating exchanges, thematic networks, and multi‑stakeholder engagement across public/private sectors, academia and think tanks at all administrative levels. - Build CSO/CBO and network capacities through training, coaching, exchanges and knowledge sharing. - Organise local‑to‑regional knowledge‑sharing and networking events, and host regional/international exchanges to enable cross‑country learning. Output 2.3 - Build CSO/CBO and network capacities on budgeting processes, support budget reviews and monitor allocations, spending and execution for DRR/CCA/environment initiatives. - Provide ongoing coaching and mentoring, including workshops, procurement and risk‑management guidance, MEAL, while supporting implementation of activities with communities. - Execute structured engagement with authorities and wider stakeholders (private sector, academia, media) and adapt advocacy efforts using evidence from case studies, policy briefs and documentation. Output 3.1 - Conduct advocacy workshops, debate sessions, and social‑accountability rollouts to localise messages, mobilise action, and bring community evidence into public dialogue platforms and media. - Support and coach CSOs/CBOs on public campaigning, covering messaging, media outreach, and adapt based on reach and engagement. - Build media collaborations by training, preparing press kits, co‑producing radio/social content, maintaining media contacts, and facilitating CSO/CBO-media partnerships. Output 3.2 - Connect CSOs/CBOs members to multi‑level policy dialogue platforms and local/regional/national advocacy networks and support their participation. - Support advocacy processes, including context analysis‑informed strategies, roll‑out, monitoring and adaptation. - Facilitate collaborative development, validation and dissemination of policy briefs/position papers, and track institutional responses to inform continued advocacy. Output 3.3 - Build CSO/CBO and network capacities in resource mobilisation, through training, stakeholder consultations and development of funding strategies, while documenting and sharing best practices and success stories. - Strengthen social accountability by establishing community scorecards, transparency boards, grievance channels, and inclusive public reviews/audits of local plans and budgets, ensuring citizen inputs contribute to environment, DRR and climate priorities. - Facilitate learning and exchange through reflection sessions, and feedback loops between communities, CSOs/CBOs and authorities. - Enable multi‑stakeholder engagement by conducting stakeholder surveys, integrating results into plans, and organising forums/workshops to maintain an active climate‑adaptation dialogue platform.
